tasks.title: Native C++/Qt Engine - Headless Core + Tests
tasks.verification_method: 'cmake --build native/build && ctest --test-dir native/build' passes (27 tests, 76 assertions)
tasks.description: Started the C++/Qt rewrite (decision: ship one native codebase to Android/Windows/Linux instead of continuing the Python/BeeWare path). Ported models.py, ep.py, accelerated.py, engine.py/engine_v2.py, multi_container.py, and the catalog CRUD from logic.py into native/core/ as a header-only C++20 library, with a doctest suite covering the same scenarios as the (now-fixed) Python tests. No Qt dependency yet.

tasks.title: Plain-C Engine - Headless Core + Tests
tasks.verification_method: cmake --build native_c/build && ctest --test-dir native_c/build (27 tests, 0 failed)
tasks.description: Decision: reproduce the app in plain C instead, with raw per-platform native UI (Win32 on Windows, Android NDK+JNI+Kotlin shell on Android) and a real trained ML placement model, rather than continuing the C++/Qt path (kept as-is at native/, nothing deleted). Ported models.py/ep.py/accelerated.py/engine.py/engine_v2.py/multi_container.py/logic.py's catalog CRUD into native_c/core/ as a C11 static library: plain structs, manual growable arrays replacing std::vector/unordered_set, a hand-written xorshift32 PRNG per engine instance, qsort-based sorting via precomputed keys (C comparators can't capture context), and a hand-rolled JsonValue for catalog persistence. Tests use a small self-written header-only harness (no external dependency, to avoid the doctest/MinGW-toolchain-path friction hit in the C++ build).

tasks.title: Plain-C Engine - Win32 Smoke-Test App
tasks.verification_method: cmake --build native_c/build -DOMNIPACK_C_BUILD_WIN32_APP=ON, run omnipack_win32_app.exe, click 'Pack Sample', confirm the packed result appears as text
tasks.description: Raw Win32 app (native_c/win32_app/main.c): WinMain/RegisterClassEx/CreateWindowEx/WndProc, a BUTTON + read-only multiline EDIT control. Clicking the button calls omnipack_core_c with the same hardcoded sample used in the Qt smoke test. No 3D rendering yet - text summary only, matching the Qt smoke test's scope.

tasks.title: Plain-C Engine - Android NDK + JNI + Kotlin Shell
tasks.verification_method: cd android_app && ./gradlew assembleDebug (BUILD SUCCESSFUL, both ABIs); installed app-debug.apk on AVD omnipack_test (android-34 google_apis x86_64), launched MainActivity, tapped Pack Sample, screenshots confirm correct packed output rendered via JNI; logcat clean of AndroidRuntime errors/fatals
tasks.description: Installed JDK 17 (Microsoft OpenJDK), Android SDK cmdline-tools, platform-tools, platform 34, build-tools 34.0.0, NDK 26.3.11579264, cmake 3.22.1, emulator + system-image (android-34, google_apis, x86_64) to C:\Android\sdk (checksums verified against official published hashes). Added android_app/: Gradle project (AGP 8.5.2, Kotlin 1.9.24) with a minimal Kotlin MainActivity (button + scrollable TextView, mirrors the Win32 smoke test) and a JNI bridge (android_app/app/src/main/cpp/jni_bridge.c) that compiles native_c/core/ directly via CMake (no source duplication) into libomnipack_jni.so for arm64-v8a and x86_64. Verified end-to-end on an AVD (Pixel 5, Android 14, x86_64): APK installs, launches, tapping "Pack Sample" calls into the C engine via JNI and renders the packed result (matches the Win32 smoke test output), no crashes in logcat.

tasks.title: Plain-C Engine - ML Placement Model
tasks.verification_method: Trained model integrated into native_c/core/engine.c as an alternative scoring mode, benchmarked against the GRASP heuristic on held-out scenarios
tasks.description: Real trained model (not just a smarter heuristic): (1) data-generation script producing many (scenario -> chosen placement) examples via the existing engines, (2) a small supervised model trained in Python to score/rank candidate placements, (3) a hand-written C inference function (small matrix-vector ops, no ML runtime dependency) wired into engine.c. Substantial standalone effort - dataset design, training, and integration - deserves its own scoping pass.
